title: How to Set Up Sales Tax in Business Central (2025)

chapters.title: Introduction and overview of sales tax setup
Creating tax groups and tax area codes
Applying tax area codes to customers and vendors
Completing the setup and document automation

features.name: Assisted setup guide for sales tax
features.description: A guided wizard that helps users set up sales tax in Business Central, including creating tax groups and configuring tax calculations.
caveats: Requires pre-existing general ledger accounts for tax tracking
Users can customize tax area code names as needed

features.name: Tax group assignment to items
features.description: Ability to assign tax groups to items to indicate whether sales tax applies to specific products bought and sold.

features.name: Tax area codes with jurisdiction filtering
features.description: Create tax area codes that calculate sales tax based on customer or vendor location with filters for specific jurisdictions like city, county, and state.
caveats: Tax area code names must be unique
Filters can be applied by city or other jurisdiction criteria

features.name: Apply tax area codes to customers and vendors
features.description: Assign tax area codes to customer and vendor master records to ensure correct tax calculations on transactions.
caveats: Can be assigned manually through customer and vendor lists
Can be updated when jurisdiction boundaries change

features.name: Automatic sales tax calculation on documents
features.description: Business Central automatically calculates sales tax on sales and purchase documents based on assigned tax area codes to customers and vendors.
